title: orchestration-decision template variables
description: Values for templates/orchestration-decision.md.j2 and templates/orchestration-decision.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from orchestration-decision.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: One named handle accountable for the topology. When the cost multiplier is questioned at month end, this is who answers.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Two sentences citing the measured single-agent baseline and why it is not enough. Single agent is the default - this field is where you overturn it, with numbers you actually ran.

scoped_context.title: Scoped context
scoped_context.description: Exactly which subset of context crosses each hand-off. The failure mode is passing everything - cost multiplies and the sub-agent starts answering the parent's question instead of its own.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case id naming the workflow this decision binds - "invoice-triage-orchestration". One workflow per record; a repo-wide topology decision is how every stage ends up paying for a judge.

success_criteria.title: Success criteria
success_criteria.description: How a sub-agent knows it is finished, stated so a machine could check it. "A good summary" is not a criterion; "JSON validates against schema X and cites at least two source ids" is.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Which topology you are committing to. single is the default and needs no defence; the other three each add a hand-off, and every hand-off is a place context is lost and tokens are spent again.
